notes.title: Anima: Gate of Memories I & II Remaster – An Action-RPG Saga Reforged
notes.notes:
This release rebuilds [b]Gate of Memories[/b] and [b]The Nameless Chronicles[/b] from the ground up, with enhanced visuals, rebalanced combat, and gameplay improvements on a single new title. Whether you're a longtime fan or discovering Gaia for the first time, this is the ultimate way to experience the saga.

Prepare to (re)discover the world of Gaia, the way it's meant to be experienced!

Coming later this year!

notes.title: Anima Song from the Abyss new Trailer and Kickstarter page is LIVE
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We want to announce that Anima Song from the Abyss, the new game from Anima Project, has started its Kickstarter campaign and presents its first trailer.

Anima Song from the Abyss is an action role-playing game (ARPG) with hack and slash style elements in which players explore an interconnected world. The game is the third entry set in the world of Gaïa, from the renowned roleplaying book franchise Anima Beyond Fantasy. The game allows you to control two different characters, the knight Soren and the strange entity Noein through a journey that will take them across the remains of an ancient extinct civilization to discover the secret of its fall...

You can check the trailer in the next link:
https://youtu.be/omzviwu7Wwg

We hope that you will enjoy it!

notes.title: Patch 1.02 Released
notes.notes:
PATCH NOTES 1.02
-Fixed a bug that caused an unexpected crash of the game.
-Fixed a bug in which the rotation of the projectiles depended on the framerate.
-Fixed a bug in the texts of Velez Shop after having bought all the available items.
-Fixed a bug that allowed you to get off the stage by climbing the wall of a cave.
-Minor corrections of some texts in Spanish.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.notes:

Fixed a bug that made that sometimes one item didn’t appear.
Fixed a bug that made that some Achievements didn’t appear.
